name: Filter Format Audit
description: Audits text (filter) formats to identify content that could be affected by format changes — a security/QA tool.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 Filter format audit lets you analyse your content to find where an input filter may be stripping out tags or attributes.

 Use cases include:

 
 When you've changed your filter formats over time and need to identify existing content that is being impacted by the changes 
 You've migrated content from another system and need to identify when tags/attributes are being stripped 
 You had a lax filter format, and now need to make it secure 
 
 Back to top 

 Configuration/Installation/Usage 
 
 Download and install the module like normal 
 Visit admin/content/filter-format-audit and hit 'run analysis' 
 Let it do its thing ⏳ 
 Review the results and edit your formats/content as required 
 Rinse and repeat from step 2 onwards until you're happy ♻️ 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 Requires the Dynamic Entity Reference module. Version 1 will suffice.
